summary: Frontend-only test of per-category color stripe on Label Rak PDFs (Produk Satuan + Paket Bundling) and legend swatches. Created TEST_ products (Benih, Pestisida, Alat Tani) + TEST_ bundle via API, logged in as admin, downloaded shelf-label PDFs at sizes 4×2, 3×1,5, 5×3 for both tabs. Rendered each PDF with pymupdf @200dpi and sampled pixel color inside the left stripe for every label. All 15 samples match the expected RGB within ±2/channel (anti-alias tolerance): Pupuk (27,94,59), Benih (217,119,6), Pestisida (200,40,40), Alat Tani (37,99,235), Paket (124,58,237). Legend badges show correct inline background colors on both tabs (label-category-legend and bundle-label-category-legend). Label selection, size picker, and PDF download work with no JS runtime errors. All TEST_ data cleaned up; user's product 'ZA' intact; no transactions created.

pdf_pixel_verification.sampling: DPI=200, point at (x0+col*w + stripe_width/2, y0+row*h + h/2) using CATEGORY layout from exporter.printShelfLabels

critical_code_review_comments: exporter.js printShelfLabels: stripe width sw = max(1.2, 1.5*s) mm scales nicely across sizes; color sampled at stripe centerline matches CATEGORY_COLORS exactly (within +/-2 due to PDF rendering AA). Good.
categoryColor fallback for custom categories uses deterministic char-sum % EXTRA_COLORS[6] — stable across renders. OK.
LabelSelectBar legend testids are tab-scoped via tid prop (label-category-legend / bundle-label-category-legend). Good.

Pre-existing hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be child of <option> for product-category-filter options (DaftarHarga.jsx L115). Not caused by this feature but worth cleaning up — remove the <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper injection from option children, or render plain string.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ products (TEST-BNH-1 Benih, TEST-PST-1 Pestisida, TEST-ALT-1 Alat Tani) and 1 TEST_ bundle (TEST_Paket) via API; deleted all afterwards. User's product 'ZA' untouched; no transactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-verify category stripe colors: login as admin, visit /daftar-harga, choose size via [data-testid=label-size-select], click [data-testid=print-shelf-labels-button] (or [data-testid=bundle-print-labels-button] after clicking [data-testid=view-bundling]). Save PDF then run /app/test_reports/verify_category_colors.py which samples pixel inside the left stripe for each label and compares to CATEGORY_COLORS. Note: LabelSizePicker testid is NOT prefixed by tid; both tabs use plain [data-testid=label-size-select].
